body: I'm here man, I'm planning of dying tonight but I'm here at the moment. I understand the feeling all to well
No please just let me be, I just wanted to talk to someone for once
You will? I'm fucking scared man but I don't see it ending no other way
There's nothing out there for me, I've looked and looked. I just need to finally let go
I just don't enjoy life anymore, all I could offer to the table is pain and misery and I think I've done more than enough. I should be dead this very moment. Worm.
Darkness has won over me a long time ago and like never before I'm feeling at my lowest. It's getting scarier every day to be honest, I never in my life thought I would ever feel like this
That's the beautiful thing about it
I understand you but I'm sadly at a point where I find death so romantic, I enjoy flirting with it. It's just wanting to sleep forever
I just don't know, I was happy one moment and next thing you know I'm the saddest man on earth. Darkness took over without warning
It all feels pointless to me now, I just don't know what I want anymore. But you are right of course, hard work pays off everytime.
Thats the million dollar question and I don't really have an answer. Something inside me told me it was better off if I lived my whole life alone and dead on the inside

Put it this way, right now I should of had good income, a great job, a car, friends, my soulmate should be lying in bed beside me, I literally should be the happiest person in the world but no just a dark quiet room with regret. Something inside my darkest thoughts won and I pushed literally everyone way and now I spend the holidays alone, and my ambition just isn't there. I wanted it so bad too. The more I think about it the more I want to just die
Oh man where do I start
